description: A counterparty with no declared jurisdiction is undeclared, not unknown.
note: The input carries a .de identifier AND a German postal address, and both are ignored. An implementation that reads either one fails this vector, which is the point of putting them there. A .de domain is registrable from anywhere and a postal address is where post goes -- each correlates with jurisdiction and neither IS jurisdiction, which is a legal fact about a legal person. `undeclared` is also not `unknown`: nobody was asked, which is a different statement from an operator having been asked and not knowing.
